nom: Drunk Elephant Lippe Balm Lip Moisturizer

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry lips or dry skin describe cracked, chapped, or peeling lips becoming soft, smooth, and flake-free after regular use, often citing shea butter and avocado oil.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who identify as having sensitive skin report the fragrance-free formula does not irritate and feels safe to use.
segments.mature: One reviewer going through menopause noted her lips looked fuller and less thin after switching to this balm, crediting the peptides.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the balm as deeply hydrating, quenching dryness overnight or within days of use; one reviewer found it only addresses immediate dryness without lasting or soaking in, and another said it dried up fast and left lips feeling dull.

aspects.libelle: High price for amount of product

extraits.texte: This balm is AMAZING. It's everything my dry/chapped and peeling skin needed. Other products I used seemed to leave a film or never fully hydrate my lips, causing me to a) run through the product faster and/or b) use it more frequently. With Drunk Elephant Lippe Balm - the game is changed - I used it once, and my lips feel like silk on pillows. It's lasted for at least an hour now. Very impressed with the ingredients, the culture, and the trust :) I'd consider and recommend buying/trying any of their products now!

extraits.titre: Best thing is that is has no smell
extraits.texte: I recently tried the Lippie Balm from Drunk Elephant, and I'm seriously impressed. My lips are usually extremely dry, but after just three days of use, they're soft, smooth, and fully restored, no more flakiness. The formula is rich and hydrating without being sticky, and it really lasts. Honestly, this is the best lip product I've ever used. If you struggle with dry lips like I do. Complimentary from DrunkElephant.

So, switching over from a chocolate scented/flavored balm, I wasn't sold on the natural scent/flavor of this one, at first. However, the more I use it, the more I love it. It goes on so smooth, makes my lips feel comfortable and nourished, and I feel like it's doing something extra for my lips that my other balm wasn't doing. Maybe it's the peptides in it? (Being menopausal, I had noticed my lips hadn't been looking as full and lush as they used to.) But I feel like they are looking and feeling better now - and I am finding myself reaching for this one most often. I may need to make it a permanent staple in my stash!

I applied this lip balm every few hours and it leaves my lips feeling soft and hydrated every time! I would say this is great for someone who has super sensitive skin and is worried about a reaction or someone who doesn't love scented products since this one is unscented. The packaging is nice too because it fits so nicely in my pocket. Gifted by drunkelephant

Nice compact lip balm that keeps my lips soft and hydrated. This one does not leave my lips feeling waxy which is a plus. Additionally there is no fragrance and safe for sensitive skin. I received this product, complimentary from DrunkElephant in exchange my honest review

I was excited to try this after reading a chunk of reviews and looking at the okay ingredients. This balm feels nice when first applying it, but I very quickly found out that it dries up fast and makes your lips feel dull. The balm does not stand up to the winter, wind, or wind chill. Spend your money elsewhere.

This product was gifted by drunk elephant in exchange for my honest review: I'm sad to say that I'm not a fan of this lip balm. The lip balm feels really oily, so it's greasy and makes my lips prone to getting sunburnt. I also don't like how cheap the packaging feels and how thick the applicator is. Not a fan!
